pt.r: O Parque Nacional de Shenandoah fica na Virgínia, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 805 km² e está protegido desde 1935, sob gestão do Serviço Nacional de Parques dos EUA (NPS). Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.

en.r: Shenandoah National Park is a national park in Virginia, United States. It covers 805 km² and has been protected since 1935. It is managed by the U.S. National Park Service. en.r: Caledon State Park is a state park in Virginia, United States. It has been protected since 1974.
en.h: A 10.5 km² state park in King George, Virginia, on the Potomac River. en.ff: Frequent rain and high elevation create habitats rare in the southern Appalachians, such as mountain bogs, vernal ponds and red spruce wetlands.
